hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-blue-600

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadows for depth (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 on cards, subtle and crisp.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay (using an SVG noise filter or CSS background) over the hero and dark sections to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on cards. Buttons scale slightly with color shift.

component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped, high contrast, smooth background color transitions. The primary CTA should be bold blue.
component_name.cards: Solid white background, 1px subtle border, soft shadow on hover. Never muddy glassmorphism for content cards.
component_name.inputs: Clean inputs with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent.

grids.bento_grid: Use for USP section. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Make some items span 2 columns.
grids.general: Responsive grid-cols-1 to md:grid-cols-2 or 3 for services.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections. gap-8 to gap-16 between elements. Allow elements to breathe.
layouts.hero: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center items-start pt-32 pb-20 relative overflow-hidden

motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up on route changes.
motion.reveals: Scroll-triggered line-by-line text reveals for headings. Staggered fade-up for grid items.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the tech stack or manifesto phrases.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero abstract shapes or background images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary blue meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for decorative SVG shapes.

media.images: Use clipped frames or spotlight treatment for real photography.
media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for a premium tech feel.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2.5D parallax or a subtle abstract CSS/SVG moving gradient in the hero to maintain high performance.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue glass 3D shapes for hero section background or visual accent.
Professional developer portrait for the Founder/About snippet section.
Modern office interior to be used as a deliberate cropped background in Services or Process page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, sonner, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Use framer-motion for the kinetic hero (masked line-by-line reveal) and scroll animations.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout.
Ensure the hero has a subtle parallax or floating interaction using framer-motion.
Implement a slow editorial marquee (e.g., using react-fast-marquee) for the tech stack or core agency values.
Do NOT add any testimonials, client logos, or fake social proof. Credibility comes from the tech stack and process.
Contact form must be purely frontend with a fake loading and success state (use Sonner for the success toast).
Build a 'Book a Consultation' modal using Radix UI or Shadcn Dialog, accessible from the global CTA buttons.
Process page must use a numbered timeline (1 to 12) with connecting line animations on scroll.
All components must be accessible, use standard semantic HTML tags.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_slop: Create distinctive designs. Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.depth: Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl) where appropriate.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: NEVER use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions for interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.alignment: DO NOT center align the app container. Use natural left-aligned reading flows where appropriate.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.buttons: Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with clear hover scale/color shifts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. NEVER use AI emojis as icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., py-24, gap-12). Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., contact form success).
